rows.question: For Albany International, what was the year-end patent portfolio in aerospace technologies?
rows.answer:
I could not find this in the reports. The reports do not break out the patent portfolio by aerospace technologies or give a year-end count for that category.

The closest related figure is the total active portfolio: "Our active portfolio currently contains over 2,300 patents, and approximately 160 new patents are typically granted each year" [albany.pdf p.16]. That figure covers all of the company's patents and gives no year-end date or aerospace split.

rows.question: How many patents did Aurora Innovation hold at year end?
rows.answer: Aurora had "over 1,300 awarded and pending patents worldwide" [aurora.pdf p.9]. The passage doesn't state a specific date for this count. The same paragraph gives its team figures "As of December 31, 2022," so the patent count is likely from around that time, but the report does not explicitly say it is a year-end figure.

rows.question: What was the non-performing loan ratio for FNCB Bancorp at year end?
rows.answer: At year end 2022, FNCB's ratio of non-performing loans to total gross loans was **0.25%**, down from **0.39%** at December 31, 2021 [fncb.pdf p.52]. The risk factors section gives the same figures: 0.25% at December 31, 2022 and 0.39% at December 31, 2021 [fncb.pdf p.21].

rows.question: What was Albany International Corp.'s net cash provided by operating activities in 2022?
rows.answer: Albany International Corp.'s net cash provided by operating activities in 2022 was $128,214 thousand (about $128.2 million). [albany.pdf p.44] The consolidated statement of cash flows reports the same figure. [albany.pdf p.61]

rows.question: What was the amount paid in dividends by Albany International Corp. during 2022?
rows.answer: The reports don't give the total dollar amount of dividends paid in 2022. The excerpts include only the per-share figure: dividends declared were $0.88 per share for Class A and Class B common stock in 2022 [albany.pdf p.58]. The shareholders' equity statement that would show the dividend total is cut off at the "Dividends declared" line [albany.pdf p.107], so I could not find the aggregate amount.

rows.question: What was Albany International Corp.'s effective tax rate for 2022?
rows.answer: Albany International Corp.'s effective tax rate for 2022 was 26.9%, on a tax amount of $35,472 thousand [albany.pdf p.41]. The same 26.9% rate appears in the reconciliation in Note 7 [albany.pdf p.85].

rows.question: What was the amount of net cash used in investing activities for Armadale Capital Plc in 2022?
rows.answer:
In the consolidated statement of cash flows, Armadale Capital Plc's net cash used in investing activities for 2022 was £(840) thousand (shown as (840) in £'000) [armadale.pdf p.27].

The company-only statement on the following page reports a different figure: net cash used in investing activities of £(1,118) thousand for 2022 [armadale.pdf p.28].

rows.question: What is the name of the self-driving platform developed by Aurora Innovation, Inc.?
rows.answer: Aurora Innovation, Inc. is developing the **Aurora Driver**, an advanced and scalable suite of self-driving hardware, software and data services designed as a platform to adapt and interoperate amongst vehicle types and applications [aurora.pdf p.67]. It is described as a common driver platform that can integrate with vehicles of various makes, models, and classes [aurora.pdf p.10].

rows.question: What was the amount of stock-based compensation recognized for related party RSUs by Aurora Innovation, Inc. for the year ended December 31, 2022?
rows.answer: Aurora Innovation, Inc. recognized **$6 million** of stock-based compensation for related party RSUs for the twelve months ended December 31, 2022 [aurora.pdf p.76].

rows.question: What was the valuation allowance at the end of the period for Aurora Innovation, Inc. as of December 31, 2022?
rows.answer: The valuation allowance at the end of the period was **$542** as of December 31, 2022 [aurora.pdf p.81]. The excerpt does not state the unit for this table, so I cannot confirm whether the figure is in millions.

rows.question: What percentage of the ordinary share capital of Brave Bison Limited, Greenlight Digital Limited, and Greenlight Commerce Limited was transferred to Brave Bison 2021 Limited during the year?
rows.answer: **100%** of the ordinary share capital of Brave Bison Limited, Greenlight Digital Limited and Greenlight Commerce Limited was transferred to Brave Bison 2021 Limited during the year [brave-bison.pdf p.57]. The company notes repeat this statement [brave-bison.pdf p.66].

rows.question: What was the revenue growth percentage for Brave Bison Group plc in 2022?
rows.answer:
Brave Bison's revenue grew by **46%** in 2022, to £31.7 million (2021: £21.7 million) [brave-bison.pdf p.8].

The Results and Dividends section gives the same 46% increase, but states the 2021 base as £21.6 million [brave-bison.pdf p.26]. The two reports differ by £0.1 million on the prior-year figure, though both give 46% growth.

rows.question: What method does Brave Bison Group plc use to determine the fair value of equity instruments granted in share-based payment transactions?
rows.answer: Brave Bison Group plc determines the fair value of equity instruments granted in share-based payment transactions by using the Black-Scholes method [brave-bison.pdf p.45]. The company's separate share-based payments note uses the same method [brave-bison.pdf p.64].

rows.question: What was the number of shares outstanding for FNCB Bancorp, Inc. as of March 11, 2023?
rows.answer: FNCB Bancorp, Inc. had 19,682,689 shares of common stock outstanding as of March 11, 2023 [fncb.pdf p.7].

rows.question: What was FNCB Bancorp, Inc.'s tax-equivalent net interest margin in 2022?
rows.answer: FNCB's tax-equivalent net interest margin was 3.38% in 2022 [fncb.pdf p.40]. This was a decline of 7 basis points from 3.45% in 2021 [fncb.pdf p.3].

rows.question: What was the total number of shares bought back by Kelly Partners Group Holdings Limited from July 1, 2020, to April 7, 2021?
rows.answer: Kelly Partners Group Holdings Limited bought back **400,000 shares** between 1 July 2020 and 7 April 2021. The 16 buy-back entries in Note 27 sum to 400,000, and the share count falls from 45,400,000 to 45,000,000, which matches [kelly-partners.pdf p.59].

rows.question: What is the ownership percentage of Kelly Partners Wollongong Partnership for Kelly Partners Group Holdings Limited?
rows.answer: The Kelly Partners Wollongong Partnership (Australia) is listed with two percentages: **59.64%** and **51.00%** [kelly-partners.pdf p.80]. The excerpt does not label the columns, so I cannot say which figure is the ownership interest and which is the voting interest, or which year each applies to. The same page's footnote says ownership and voting percentages are equal for all subsidiaries [kelly-partners.pdf p.82], which does not match the two different figures shown for this entity.

rows.question: What was the revenue contribution of the acquired business by Kelly Partners Northern Beaches from 1 February 2022 to 30 June 2022?
rows.answer:
The acquired business contributed revenues of **$406,962** to the Group for the period from 1 February 2022 to 30 June 2022 [kelly-partners.pdf p.71].

The report notes that these figures may be part-year and may include implementation and restructuring costs that are one-off and non-recurring in nature [kelly-partners.pdf p.71].

rows.question: What is the total number of shares authorized for Common Stock by Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust, Inc. as of December 31, 2022?
rows.answer: As of December 31, 2022, Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust, Inc. had authority to issue 200,000,000 shares of Common Stock, with a par value of $0.01 per share [wheeler.pdf p.78]. The consolidated balance sheet shows the same figure [wheeler.pdf p.37].

rows.question: What is the trading symbol for the Notes issued by Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust, Inc.?
rows.answer: The trading symbol for the Notes is **WHLRL**, the symbol for the 7.00% Subordinated Convertible Notes due 2031, listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market [wheeler.pdf p.1]. The Notes' listing under "WHLRL" is also confirmed in the exhibit description [wheeler.pdf p.80].

rows.question: What was the same store FFO increase for Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust, Inc. during the year ended December 31, 2022?
rows.answer: Same store FFO increased by **$2.80 million** in the year ended December 31, 2022 [wheeler.pdf p.29]. The reconciliation table supports this: same store FFO was $9,027 thousand in 2022 versus $6,225 thousand in 2021, a difference of $2,802 thousand [wheeler.pdf p.29].

rows.question: What was the principal amount of the Wilmington Financing Agreement entered into by Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust, Inc. on March 12, 2021?
rows.answer: The Wilmington Financing Agreement provided for a term loan in the aggregate principal amount of $35.00 million. [wheeler.pdf p.54]

rows.question: What was the aggregate cost of the Series D Preferred shares purchased by Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust, Inc. on March 12, 2021?
rows.answer: The aggregate cost was **$6.00 million**. The Company accepted 387,097 shares of Series D Preferred at $15.50 per share in its modified Dutch auction tender offer, with the purchase on March 12, 2021, excluding fees and expenses [wheeler.pdf p.61].

rows.question: How much did Albany International Corp. spend on research and development for advanced programs?
rows.answer:
The reports do not break out spending on "advanced programs." They give company-funded research and development totals:

- Company-funded research expenses were $31.4 million in 2022, $29.6 million in 2021, and $25.8 million in 2020. In 2022 this was 3.0 percent of total Net sales. [albany.pdf p.16]
- In 2022, internally funded R&D was $31,413 thousand in total: $16,060 thousand in Machine Clothing and $15,353 thousand in Albany Engineered Composites. [albany.pdf p.39]
- The $15.4 million AEC figure was 3.6 percent of AEC Net sales in 2022. [albany.pdf p.16]

rows.question: Did Brave Bison Group plc report any mergers or acquisitions during the year?
rows.answer:
Yes. Brave Bison acquired Best Response Media during 2022 and integrated it into Brave Bison Commerce [brave-bison.pdf p.6]. The report describes this as the company's third acquisition since mid-2020 [brave-bison.pdf p.6]. Acquisition costs of £0.1 million (2021: £0.7 million) were incurred in relation to acquiring Best Response Media [brave-bison.pdf p.8].

The Greenlight acquisitions completed in 2021, not in 2022. During 2022 the company only carried out a purchase price allocation exercise for them [brave-bison.pdf p.8].

rows.question: Which leadership position changed at Kelly Partners Group Holdings Limited in the reporting period?
rows.answer:
I could not find this in the reports. The passages don't describe a leadership change during the year ended 30 June 2022.

The closest item is the appointment of Lawrence Cunningham as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective 1 July 2022 [kelly-partners.pdf p.3]. That is the day after the reporting period ended, so it doesn't count as a change within the period.

rows.question: What was Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust's cash flow from operations for the year?
rows.answer: I could not find this in the reports. The passages I have include the audit opinion, which refers to a consolidated statement of cash flows [wheeler.pdf p.34], but none of them show the cash flow from operations figure for the year. The balance sheet, statement of operations, and notes are present, but they do not give that number.

The most recent total revenue in the reports is for fiscal 2022: $1,034.9 million [albany.pdf p.3], or $1,034,887 thousand in the revenue recognition table [albany.pdf p.72].

rows.answer: I could not find this in the reports. The passages I searched cover the consolidated balance sheet, the statement of operations, and the company overview, and none of them mention a tenant satisfaction score.
